tools.name: list_canonical_products
tools.when_to_use: Find the canonical product for a GTIN, or browse canonical products; cursor paginated.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need supplier-specific products (use the catalog service) or prices (use the offer service).

tools.name: get_canonical_product
tools.when_to_use: Fetch a single canonical product by its internal canonical_product_id (ULID).
tools.when_not_to_use: You only have a GTIN (use list_canonical_products with the gtin filter).

tools.name: list_curation_queue
tools.when_to_use: Review supplier products awaiting an operator match decision (pending_review).
tools.when_not_to_use: Automated GTIN matches (they need no review) or normal product lookups.

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.when_to_use: Audit the curation decision journal (confirm/reject/create-new/merge), newest first; optionally one supplier product's history.
tools.when_not_to_use: You want items still awaiting review (list_curation_queue) or current canonical state (list_canonical_products).

tools.name: confirm_link
tools.when_to_use: Operator confirms a suggested supplier->canonical match; emits the confirmation.

tools.name: reject_link
tools.when_to_use: Operator rejects a suggested supplier->canonical match.

tools.name: create_new_canonical
tools.when_to_use: Operator declares a curation item a brand-new canonical product and links it confirmed.
tools.when_not_to_use: The suggested candidate is correct (confirm_link) or an existing canonical fits.

tools.name: merge_canonical_products
tools.when_to_use: Operator merges a duplicate canonical into another; all its links move to the target.
tools.when_not_to_use: The two products are genuinely different; a single supplier link is wrong (reject_link).
